column1: # What enforces each requirement in this library's specs (0024-spec-format FR-011 - FR-014).
# mechanism: check | gate | review | none. by: "<repo>: <command>" for check and gate, the defining requirement for review, "-" for none.

column4: note
suite/layers.test.ts: every file of the real tree is in a unit and a file in none is layers/unclassified
suite/layers.test.ts: below may not import above and each unit imports only what its row allows
suite/layers.test.ts: the package exports the library, its layers and the dialect port
suite/layers.test.ts: verify runs every check of the library
suite/layers.test.ts: the release record agrees with the manifest and the package
suite/governance.test.ts: names are made only by their functions
suite/governance.test.ts: the catalogue has kinds for machines, zones and cloud accounts
suite/governance.test.ts: a requirement is defined or refused with every reason
suite/governance.test.ts: text that looks like a secret is found by its path
suite/governance.test.ts: each profile gives every control and the profiles are ranked
suite/governance.test.ts: an override has a reason and a date and is kept
suite/governance.test.ts: the floor is data and no control or override lowers it
suite/governance.test.ts: a change of assurance is judged by the assurance in force
suite/logical.test.ts: the order keeps what matches and refuses a requirement twice in a layer
suite/logical.test.ts: a higher layer replaces a lower one and the order records it
suite/logical.test.ts: the order is sequenced after dependencies and a missing dependency and a cycle are refused
suite/logical.test.ts: the plan says none, create, update or remove for each requirement
suite/logical.test.ts: the canonical text and digest of a plan are stable and change with any entry
suite/logical.test.ts: the approvals a plan needs follow its destructive entries, tiers and the assurance
suite/logical.test.ts: the gate opens only when each approval needed is given
suite/dialects.test.ts: a dialect is a value of the port
suite/dialects.test.ts: a dialect's guarantees are data
suite/dialects.test.ts: what a dialect expresses of a requirement
suite/dialects.test.ts: the matrix and its totals and unexpressed annotations
suite/dialects.test.ts: the plan of steps names the digest and refuses a destructive step with no check
suite/dialects.test.ts: rendered files say they are generated and their digest is stable
